% Where the Gaussian is inserted in ResNet-20-GN.
% Counts, stage widths and the bypass epoch come from data.tex, generated by
% scripts/fig_schema_data.py out of continuation/campaign_ops.py and
% scripts/campaign_manifest.py.  Nothing here is transcribed by hand.
\providecommand{\gsDir}{}
\input{\gsDir data}

\definecolor{bcblue}{HTML}{1F77B4}
\definecolor{bcred}{HTML}{D62728}
\definecolor{bcgreen}{HTML}{2CA02C}
\definecolor{bcgrey}{HTML}{7A7A7A}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
  x=1mm, y=1mm,
  font=\footnotesize,
  lab/.style={font=\scriptsize, text=black!75},
  expl/.style={font=\scriptsize, text=black!85, anchor=west},
  panel/.style={font=\bfseries\small},
  flow/.style={-{Straight Barb[length=1.5mm,width=1.4mm]}, line width=0.5pt,
               black!70},
  blk/.style={rounded corners=1pt, draw=black!55, line width=0.5pt,
              fill=black!4, minimum height=9mm},
  early/.style={blk, draw=bcblue, fill=bcblue!8},
  site/.style={draw=bcblue, fill=bcblue, line width=0.3pt,
               minimum size=1.7mm, inner sep=0pt},
  dsite/.style={site, fill=white},
  gate/.style={rounded corners=1pt, draw=black!55, line width=0.5pt,
               fill=black!4, minimum width=13mm, minimum height=8mm},
  gbox/.style={rounded corners=1pt, draw=bcblue, line width=0.7pt,
               fill=bcblue!10, minimum width=9mm, minimum height=8mm,
               text=bcblue},
]

% =====================================================================
% PANEL A -- the 19 insertion sites along ResNet-20-GN
% =====================================================================
\node[panel, anchor=west] at (0,16) {A};
\node[anchor=west] at (6,16)
  {\nSites{} insertion sites: every main-path $3\times3$ convolution};
\node[expl] at (6,11)
  {One forward hook per $3\times3$ convolution, in module order.
   Site $0$ is the stem; sites $1$--$\earlyLast$ are stage 1, which is exactly
   the \texttt{early7} set.};

% stem
\node[early, minimum width=14mm] (stem) at (13,0) {};
\node[lab] at (13,0) {stem};
\node[site] at (13,-6) {};
\node[lab, below] at (13,-8) {$0$};

% nine basic blocks: sites 1..18, two per block
\foreach \b in {0,...,8} {
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\bx}{24 + 12.6*\b}
  \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\sa}{1 + 2*\b}
  \pgfmathtruncatemacro{\sb}{2 + 2*\b}
  \ifnum\b<3
    \node[early, minimum width=11mm, anchor=west] at (\bx,0) {};
  \else
    \node[blk, minimum width=11mm, anchor=west] at (\bx,0) {};
  \fi
  \node[lab] at ({\bx+5.5},0) {\tiny block};
  \ifnum\b=3 \node[lab, above, font=\tiny, text=bcred] at ({\bx+5.5},4.6) {stride 2}; \fi
  \ifnum\b=6 \node[lab, above, font=\tiny, text=bcred] at ({\bx+5.5},4.6) {stride 2}; \fi
  \node[site] at ({\bx+3},-6) {};
  \node[site] at ({\bx+8},-6) {};
  \node[lab, below, font=\tiny] at ({\bx+3},-8) {\sa};
  \node[lab, below, font=\tiny] at ({\bx+8},-8) {\sb};
}

\node[blk, minimum width=13mm, anchor=west] (head) at (139,0) {};
\node[lab] at (145.5,0) {GAP, fc};

\draw[flow] (0,0) -- (stem.west);
\draw[flow] (stem.east) -- (24,0);
\draw[flow] (135.8,0) -- (head.west);
\draw[flow] (head.east) -- (168,0);
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (-1,7.5) {$3{\times}32{\times}32$};
\node[lab, anchor=east] at (168,7.5) {$10$};

% stage brackets: the three spatial widths of the ordinary 32x32 net
\foreach \x/\y/\w/\c/\n in {6/60.2/\groupWone/16/\groupNone,
                            61.8/98/\groupWtwo/32/\groupNtwo,
                            99.6/135.8/\groupWthree/64/\groupNthree} {
  \draw[black!45, line width=0.4pt] (\x,-13) -- (\x,-14.5) -- (\y,-14.5) -- (\y,-13);
  \node[lab, below] at ({(\x+\y)/2},-14.7)
    {$\w{\times}\w$, \c\,ch \quad \n\ sites};
}

% legend for the two insertion masks
\node[site] at (8,-23) {};
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (11,-23)
  {\texttt{all19}: every site filtered};
\node[early, minimum width=4mm, minimum height=3.5mm] at (60,-23) {};
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (64,-23)
  {\texttt{early7}: sites $0$--$\earlyLast$ only (highlighted)};

% =====================================================================
% PANEL B -- inside one BasicBlock: the hook fires on the conv output
% =====================================================================
\node[panel, anchor=west] at (0,-36) {B};
\node[anchor=west] at (6,-36) {Inside one basic block};
\node[expl] at (6,-41)
  {The hook rewrites the \emph{output of the convolution}, before GroupNorm
   and before the ReLU.};

\node[gate] (c1) at (16,-53) {conv $3{\times}3$};
\node[gbox] (g1) at (31,-53) {$G_\sigma$};
\node[gate, minimum width=8mm] (n1) at (43,-53) {\small GN};
\node[gate, minimum width=9mm] (r1) at (55.5,-53) {$\rho$};
\node[gate] (c2) at (71,-53) {conv $3{\times}3$};
\node[gbox] (g2) at (86,-53) {$G_\sigma$};
\node[gate, minimum width=8mm] (n2) at (98,-53) {\small GN};
\node[draw=black!55, circle, inner sep=0.6pt, line width=0.5pt] (add)
  at (109,-53) {$+$};
\node[gate, minimum width=9mm] (r2) at (120,-53) {$\rho$};

\draw[flow] (2,-53) -- (c1);
\foreach \a/\b in {c1/g1, g1/n1, n1/r1, r1/c2, c2/g2, g2/n2, n2/add, add/r2} {
  \draw[flow] (\a) -- (\b);
}
\draw[flow] (r2) -- (132,-53);
\node[lab, above] at (3.5,-52) {$x$};

% the parameter-free shortcut carries no convolution, so it is never hooked
\draw[flow, black!45] (5,-53) |- (7,-63) -- (109,-63) -- (add);
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (11,-65.5)
  {shortcut: identity, or option A (stride-2 subsample $+$ zero-pad) --
   no convolution, so never hooked};

% =====================================================================
% PANEL C -- the width rule
% =====================================================================
\node[panel, anchor=west] at (0,-77) {C};
\node[anchor=west] at (6,-77) {How $\sigma$ is set at each site};
\node[expl] at (6,-82)
  {The stored level is rescaled by the site's relative width, so a level means
   the same fraction of a feature map at every depth.};

\node[anchor=west] at (6,-90)
  {$\sigma_l(e) \;=\; q_l(e)\,L[e][l], \qquad
    q_l(e) \;=\; \dfrac{\text{width at site } l \text{ now}}
                       {\text{width at site } l \text{ at } 32\times32}$};

\node[lab, anchor=west] at (6,-101)
  {\texttt{R32}: $q_l = 1$ everywhere.};
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (6,-106)
  {\texttt{input\_*} reduction to $r$: $q_l = r/32$ at all \nSites{} sites.};
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (6,-111)
  {\texttt{stem\_*} reduction to $r$: site $0$ keeps $q_0 = 1$, the other
   $18$ get $r/32$.};
\node[lab, anchor=west] at (6,-116)
  {From epoch $\bypassEpoch$ of $\nEpochs$, $\sigma = 0$: an exact identity,
   and the plain network trains to the end.};

\end{tikzpicture}
